propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) in adapters/jira/acli_graph.py paginate through a nextPageToken cursor but existing test coverage exercises only one page and never validates multi-page pagination
The readers terminate on isLast OR on null/absent nextPageToken, but no test independently asserts either stop condition in isolation or verifies the cursor token advances correctly across requests
A repeated cursor token can cause infinite re-requests (same-token-twice defect), with the fail-open exception handler converting the spin into a silently partial map not caught by existing oracles
A short page (fewer items than requested page_size) should not terminate pagination, but this regression was transplanted from DC and requires a dedicated short-page test variant to detect

Comprehensive multi-page test module (521 lines) with mutation-verified oracles was landed as change 1255 to close the parity gap with DC's test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py, including structural AST guard to prevent future unpaginated whole-project readers

A separate Cloud defect (repeated cursor token causing infinite spin) was discovered during test implementation and filed as rebar:cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c, recorded as strict xfail in AC4 pending production fix
